description: When a call fails with a daily-limit error, or your operator asks what alalanet costs. No arguments; changes and costs nothing, and answers also when the quota is used up. Returns the free limits (checks and live checks per day per client), each paid plan (id, USD price for 30 days and for 365 days, daily limits, watched services, client addresses a day, an Org plan's repositories) and the payment networks with their coin (USDC on Base, USDT elsewhere), token contract and receiving address. A plan id goes to create_invoice; buying a plan is a spend for the user to approve. Without a plan, one check over x402 on this server (USDC on Base or Solana, no account; the pay_per_call object comes with the quota error): $0.005 a live check at /x402/check?url=<endpoint>, $0.01 an install check at /x402/install-check?target=<target>, $0.05 a repository check at /x402/repo-config-check?repo=<owner/name>.
name: list_plans
title: Plans and payment networks
